items.source:
Note that some ClassLoaders do not expose the package metadata,
hence this class might not be able to determine the Spring version
in all environments. Consider using a reflection-based check instead —
for example, checking for the presence of a specific Spring method that you
intend to call.
items.translation: 注意，某些 ClassLoader 不公开包元数据，因此该类可能无法在所有环境中确定 Spring 版本。请考虑使用基于反射的检查——例如，检查是否存在您打算调用的特定 Spring 方法。

items.source: Return the full version string of the present Spring codebase, or null if it cannot be determined.
items.translation: 返回当前 Spring 代码库的完整版本字符串，如果无法确定则返回 `null`。
